children: Corporate earnings this week featured key reports from six S&P 500 companies across consumer discretionary, consumer staples, industrials, and technology: AutoZone, Inc.

Earnings performance was solid, as 5 of the 6 reporting companies surpassed consensus EPS estimates while 1 matched expectations, resulting in zero bottom-line misses. On a Y/Y basis, 5 out of 6 firms expanded profits.
Revenue results were generally positive, with 4 companies topping Wall Street expectations and 2 falling short. Overall, 5 of the 6 firms achieved Y/Y top-line growth.
Let’s take a look at some of the companies that reported earnings this week:

Cintas raised its full-year guidance for fiscal 2027 revenue to $12.15B–$12.27B and adjusted EPS to $5.45–$5.54, while reaffirming plans to complete the UniFirst acquisition by the end of 2026.
